summary: Application Design Center allows editing of Terraform code generated from templates and applications.
extended_definition: Application Design Center allows editing of Terraform code generated from templates and applications.

supporting_pages.title: Manage applications \_|\_ Application Design Center \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: You'll learn how to create an application draft from a template, configure its components, edit its underlying Terraform code, create a new revision, and finally, delete the application when it's no longer needed.
Edit Terraform code Your application generates Terraform code to reflect design and configuration details.
To edit the Terraform code, do the following: From the design canvas, click Code .

supporting_pages.title: "Design application templates \_|\_ Application Design Center \_|\_ Google\
evidence_snippets: Edit Terraform code As you design your application template, Application Design Center generates Terraform code to reflect the design and configuration details.
To edit the Terraform code, do the following: From the design canvas, click Code .

The system generates the following Terraform files: main.tf : Infrastructure code that includes a module for each component in the template. outputs.tf : Exposes information about infrastructure components that are deployed. variables.tf : Declares name, type, and description for variables used in the main.tf file. input.tfvars : Defines values for variables used in the main.tf file. providers.tf : Defines labels that help Terraform interact with Google Cloud APIs and resources.
